name: Scene Compression
description: Declarative preset for folding novel scenes into fewer filmable events. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Keep the load-bearing turn while dropping travel and repeated talk.
writing_goals: Merge consecutive talks that share one conflict
Drop travel that does not change knowledge or alliance
constraints: Do not compress by inventing a new plot device
Do not erase a character whose later function remains
checklist: No essential witness was deleted silently
